localChanges: Messages that open with a nation now start with a capital letter ("The Sioux Nation has been defeated by the Aztec Empire!"), while a nation later in a sentence keeps its lower-case "the" (closes #359).

Messages about a city being captured or destroyed, or nuclear weapons being used, now name who did it at the end ("Our city Tenochtitlan has been captured by Barbarians!"), so they read right for every civilization.
